title: Answer: no settled account, the macro subject is the open problem

statements.text: The view has no settled account of the self. On constitutive panpsychist forms a macro subject must be built from micro subjects, which the subject-summing problem questions, and Goff argues that panpsychism makes macro subjects fundamental instead.

sources.quote: given any group of subjects and any further subject, it seems possible for the group to exist without that further subject existing
Panpsychism entails that o-subjects are fundamental.
